name: Sacred Earth - Alternative
source:
Play as a lone girl who has awoken after a long slumber, and travel to learn and remember just what happened here, and where all of your friends have gone.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2257360/Sacred_Earth__Alternative]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演一个在长时间沉睡后醒来的孤独女孩，前往旅行以了解并记住这里发生的事情以及所有朋友都去了哪里。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2257360/Sacred_Earth__Alternative]Steam[/url]]
